meta.description: Albums that haven't been fully identified yet — either no AcoustID fingerprints have been computed for the tracks or no MusicBrainz release-group has been matched. Both are prerequisites: fingerprints power per-track recognition + duplicate detection, and the MBID anchor unlocks cover lookups, canonical tags, and tracklist matching. Run "Identify all" to fingerprint + match the whole library in one pass.
meta.label: Album not yet identified

meta.description: Albums where Vorbis tags drift from MusicBrainz's canonical values, are missing a required field (title / artist / year / genre), or are missing the *_SORT variants used by Plex and Roon for sidebar alphabetization. Fix applies all MusicBrainz-derivable corrections in one click and falls back to AI only for fields the resolver can't fill (genre, or anything on an unanchored album).
meta.label: Tags don't match canonical

meta.description: Albums whose track-number sequence has gaps (1, 2, 4) or repeats (1, 2, 2). Detected from tag inspection — fingerprints not required to detect, but Fix uses them when available. Cascade: MB title match → AcoustID fingerprint match → AI. Note: this is about the TAG; the duplicate-tracks check catches duplicate AUDIO regardless of tag.
meta.label: Track-number gaps & duplicates

meta.description: Clusters of albums whose album_artist values are credit permutations of the same primary artist ("Ray Conniff" / "Ray Conniff & His Orchestra" / "Ray Conniff, his Orchestra and Chorus") but whose sort tags don't agree. Setting the same album_artist_sort across the cluster groups them under one entry in Plex / Roon sidebars.
meta.label: Inconsistent artist sort

meta.description: Albums missing both embedded cover art and a sidecar cover.jpg / folder.jpg / front.jpg. Fix tries MusicBrainz / Cover Art Archive first (free) and falls back to AI only when MB doesn't have a cover. Albums with a recent failed lookup are skipped so bulk passes don't keep retrying dead-ends.
meta.label: No cover art

meta.description: Albums with multiple files AcoustID identified as the same canonical recording — i.e. literal copies of the same audio. Requires fingerprints first (run "Albums not yet fingerprinted" or click Fix on a track-gaps finding). The Resolve dialog lets you pick which copy to keep.
meta.label: Duplicate audio files

meta.description: Albums where one or more FLAC filenames don't match your configured filename template (Settings → Filename templates). Filenames drift over time: different rippers use different conventions, metadata edits happen after the rip, you change your preferred format. The Resolve dialog shows current → expected for every track and renames in one safe two-pass operation.
meta.label: Filename doesn't match template
